format: RNS1 + little-endian int32 count + 32-byte source hash; each 4h row: int32 GHA tenths of arcmin, int16 signed declination tenths of arcmin, int16 signed four-hour d tenths of arcmin
interpolation: Printed p.73: Sun GHA adds exactly 15 deg/hour. Declination adds signed d * elapsed-hours/4. No SUNDRIFT or port GMT-1 subtraction. Physical SD comes from date at plain UTC+TT-UT, not from F VIII a second time.
generator: python Tools/solar-sight/build_campaign.py (writes artifacts only; compare before copying the resulting pack into Source/Data)
scope: SH5-specific table coordinates; not a replacement for the real-world astronomical ephemeris or native main-view lighting
